unsupported_specifics: I come in early, like I always have in the past 31 years
the smell of chemicals, the glassware drying on the rack at the sink, the grooves in the chalkboard from years of use
Many of my students have asked if I'm sad to be leaving
I've always told them that I'm thankful for the time I've been able to spend here
It has taught me the importance of change, no matter how slight it may be, and it has taught me patience
the bell has rung, and I'm going to go turn off the lights and give my keys back
